summary.text: Says Haxton believes the city should invest heavily in municipal housing to create affordable rental rates and act as local rent control.
summary.quote: This new approach must start with the city making a massive investment into municipal housing to be rented at truly affordable rates, which will eventually act as a form of local rent control.

summary.text: Says Haxton views housing as a human right.
Says Haxton believes Corvallis needs a mayor who keeps their promises regarding the forced dislocation of people experiencing homelessness.
summary.quote: If you believe Corvallis deserves a mayor who will keep their promises, please vote for me.
